experimental_method: Vibrating-tube densimeters (Anton Paar DMA4500, SVM3000, DSA 5000M) for density, SVM3000 for viscosity, DSA 5000M for speed of sound, at atmospheric pressure, 277-353 K, four natural geothermal brines from South Russia.
uncertainties_stated: See footnote c of Table 4: u(T)=0.01 K (DMA4500), 0.005 K (SVM3000); u(rho)=0.00025% (DMA4500), 0.01% (SVM3000), 0.005% (DSA); u(eta)=0.17%; u(W)=0.005%. Composition accuracy 0.2-1.0%.
quality_remarks: Brines are complex natural mixtures (sulfate-sodium for No. 68/129, sodium chloride for 27T/38T, ~1.7 and ~15.5 g/L). Instruments agree within 0.01-0.02%. Table 1 footnote misprint (Pwh described as wellhead temperature). Pressure only 'atmospheric'. Table 3 header last column printed 'Sample: No (%)'.
not_extracted_tables: Table 2: chemical composition, used as sample composition in mappings (mg/L), not a property table
Table 3: mass percent of ions, derived

row_counts.printed_check: printed data rows per image: group1 23, group2 30, group3 29; all written

extraction_notes: Mapping includes both rho and viscosity (group2). Composition in mg/L per block.
needs_pass2_reason: clean text layer, every cell matched page image (checked by reading the page image against the layer; I rebuilt the CSV by hand from the layer in block order)
